handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.title: How to use this textbook

handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.title: AI integration developer

handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.lead: A staged path from Python to deployment. Each stage ends with a small project.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.title: AI consulting: audits, ROI, proposals and case studies
handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.lead: How consultants find the first AI opportunity, price it and deliver it. Case studies cover real estate, education, healthcare, retail and e-commerce.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.title: Emerging AI roles: pathways built from the core chapters
handbook/Master-Freelancing-AI-and-Autom.lead: These roles are built from the chapters above, not taught as separate subjects. Demand for each should be re-checked before you promote it.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: How to use this textbook
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Admin and business support keeps a business running: the calendar, the records, the customers, the paperwork. These roles are in steady demand for remote work.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Tools and confidentiality for remote support
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: The tools behind every admin role.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Data entry, validation and quality control
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Accurate records, checked before they are saved.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Bookkeeping, reconciliation and QuickBooks
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Records, reconciliation and the boundaries of the work.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Excel and PowerPoint for business support
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Short guides; the full skills are taught in the Data and Design textbooks.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Cold calling and appointment setting, with compliance
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Respectful outreach, booking and the rules you must follow.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Remote work, payments, records and taxes
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: Practical steps; confirm every rule with the official source.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Virtual assistant (including personal and executive assistants)
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A virtual assistant (VA) supports a client remotely with email, calendar, research, documents, scheduling and admin tasks. Personal and executive assistants do similar work with more responsibility for the person they su

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Data entry specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A data entry specialist enters, checks and cleans information from documents or forms into systems and spreadsheets.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Bookkeeper (including QuickBooks consultant)
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A bookkeeper records a business's financial transactions accurately. A QuickBooks consultant sets up and maintains the QuickBooks accounting software for clients. This is record-keeping, not regulated accounting or tax a

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Excel expert
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: An Excel expert builds and maintains spreadsheets for business: models, trackers and reports. The full skills are taught in the Data Analytics textbook; this chapter covers the admin use.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: PowerPoint expert
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A PowerPoint expert builds clear, branded decks for clients: pitches, reports and training. The full design skills are taught in the Design textbook.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Cold caller and appointment setter
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A cold caller or appointment setter contacts prospects by phone to start conversations and book meetings for a client. The work is lawful only when it follows consent and calling rules, so compliance is part of every tas

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Customer service representative
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A customer service representative answers questions, solves problems and keeps customers informed by email, chat or phone. Good service turns a complaint into a repeat customer.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: CRM administrator
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A CRM administrator sets up and maintains the customer relationship management system: the fields, pipeline stages, users, automations and data quality. The system is only as good as its records.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: E-commerce virtual assistant
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: An e-commerce virtual assistant supports an online store: product listings, order processing, customer messages, stock updates and marketplace admin. The work is repetitive, so checklists and clean data matter most.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.title: Project coordinator
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Admin-Busine.lead: A project coordinator keeps a project on track: the schedule, tasks, risks, meetings and status reports. The coordinator does not own the decisions; they make sure the right people make them on time.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.title: Marketplaces compared
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: Where freelancers find clients, and how to choose.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: How to be found and how to reply.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.title: Pricing and quotes
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: Price from your costs and the client's result, not from guesses.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.title: Invoicing, payments and tax basics
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: Money rules vary; always verify officially.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: Scaling with process and quality control.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.title: 30, 60, 90 and 180-day roadmap
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: A simple plan with evidence at each step.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.title: Prompt library (104 starters)
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Business-and.lead: Starter prompts across all seven departments plus the freelance business.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: The basics every data role depends on.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Excel for analysis and reporting
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: Formulas, pivots and repeatable cleaning.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: SQL: from SELECT to window functions
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: Each query is tested against a sample database.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Power BI: model, measures, security and publishing
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: Dashboards clients can use, built on a clean data model.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Python and statistics for analysis
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: Pandas summaries (tested) and the statistics you must explain.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Advanced analytics: pipelines, warehouses and forecasting
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: The commercial side of data engineering and forecasting.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Freelance projects with sample data and solutions
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: Seven client-style projects. The first is worked in full above; the others follow the same steps with the sample database.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data analyst
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A data analyst answers business questions with data: pulls the records, cleans them, analyses patterns and communicates findings to decision makers.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data scientist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A data scientist builds models that predict or classify, from data preparation and experiments through to a tested model that the business can act on.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data engineer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A data engineer builds the pipelines that collect, clean, store and serve data so analysts and models can rely on it.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data visualisation specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A visualisation specialist designs charts and dashboards that show patterns accurately and quickly.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Business analyst
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A business analyst defines what a business needs from a system or change: requirements, processes, data needs and acceptance tests.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data mining specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A data mining specialist finds hidden patterns in large datasets: groups of customers, unusual transactions and associations between products.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Microsoft Power BI specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A Power BI specialist builds data models, measures, dashboards and secure sharing for organisations using Microsoft Power BI.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Quantitative researcher
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A quantitative researcher designs studies with numbers: surveys, experiments and statistical models that test whether a business idea or policy has a measurable effect.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: SQL developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A SQL developer writes, tunes and maintains the queries and database objects that applications and reports depend on.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: BI developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A BI developer builds the reporting layer for a business: data connections, models, dashboards and scheduled reports, usually with a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Analytics engineer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: An analytics engineer models data for analysis: transforms raw tables into clean, tested models that analysts and dashboards use, often with SQL and a transformation tool.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Financial analyst
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A financial analyst analyses money: budgets, forecasts, variance against plan, profitability and the cash position, and explains them to managers.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Python data analyst
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A Python data analyst uses Python and pandas to clean, analyse and visualise data, and to automate reports that would take hours by hand.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Data quality specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A data quality specialist defines and checks the rules that data must meet, measures how well it meets them, and works with owners to fix the causes.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.title: Reporting analyst
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Data-Analyti.lead: A reporting analyst produces the regular reports a business depends on: weekly and monthly packs, KPI updates and exception reports, delivered on time and checked.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: How to use this textbook
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: Design is a skill of seeing and deciding. This textbook teaches the principles, the professional tools and the client process, then the fifteen design professions.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Design foundations
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: The principles behind every good design, explained first in simple words.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Professional design tools
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: Twelve tools used across the design professions, with their best use.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Logo process, creative projects and design freelancing
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: How designers work with clients from brief to delivery.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Logo designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A logo designer creates the mark and wordmark that identify a business, following a brief, research and a clear concept.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Graphic designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A graphic designer creates visual communication: posters, social posts, brochures, packaging and ads, using type, image and colour to carry a message.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Web designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A web designer plans the look, layout and content of a website so visitors can find information and act. Web design overlaps with web development: the designer decides how the site should look and work; the developer bui

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Video editor
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A video editor shapes raw footage into a finished piece: cutting, pacing, sound, titles and colour, for ads, films, courses or social media.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Photo editor
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A photo editor improves and prepares photographs: exposure, colour, retouching, background cleaning and resizing for print or web.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Photoshop expert
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A Photoshop expert uses Adobe Photoshop at a high level: complex compositing, retouching, mockups, automation with actions and templates, and print preparation.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: UX designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A UX designer shapes how a product works for its users: research, journeys, flows, usability and testing. UX is about the whole experience, not the look alone.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Presentation designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A presentation designer turns content into slides that persuade and explain: decks for pitches, sales, training and board reports.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Branding designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A branding designer builds the whole identity of a business: name, logo, colour, type, voice and the rules that keep every touchpoint consistent.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: 3D modeller
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A 3D modeller creates three-dimensional objects and scenes for product visualisation, animation, games, architecture and advertising.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: UI designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A UI designer designs the screens and components of a digital product: buttons, forms, navigation, layouts and states, in a system the team can reuse.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Product designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A product designer owns the design of a product from problem to launch, working with product managers and engineers on research, interaction design and the interface.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Motion graphics designer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: A motion graphics designer adds movement to graphics and text: titles, explainers, animated logos, social ads and interface motion.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: Animation specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: An animation specialist creates characters and scenes that move: 2D or 3D animation for films, ads, games, education and product explainers.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.title: AI creative specialist
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Design-and-C.lead: An AI creative specialist uses generative tools in creative work: concept generation, image and video drafts, voice, and the review and rights checks that make the output usable for a client.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: How to use this textbook
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: This textbook teaches Development and IT from absolute zero to freelance-ready. Each profession has its own pathway, and every pathway uses the same foundations in Part 1.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Computer and internet fundamentals
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: Before you build anything for the web, you need a clear picture of what happens when someone opens a page.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Programming foundations: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, git and APIs
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: Every web profession starts with these languages and tools. You do not need to master them before you begin; you need to build and fix a small page.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Full-stack developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A full-stack developer builds both sides of a web application: the screens people see (front end) and the server, database and logic behind them (back end).

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: WordPress developer

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Web developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A web developer builds websites: the pages, layout and interactivity that visitors use. A web developer usually works with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and sometimes a content system or framework.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Shopify developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A Shopify developer builds and customises online shops on Shopify, a hosted e-commerce platform. The work covers themes (built with Liquid), apps, product data, checkout settings and integrations with payments, shipping

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Mobile app developer

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Webflow developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A Webflow developer builds websites in Webflow, a visual no-code and low-code platform that writes clean HTML, CSS and JavaScript from the layout the developer draws. Webflow also has a content management system (CMS) fo

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Front-end developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A front-end developer builds the part of a website or app that users see and use: layout, interaction, accessibility and performance. The work happens in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, often with a framework such as React.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: E-commerce developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: An e-commerce developer builds the parts of an online shop that handle money and stock: product data, carts, discounts, shipping rules, payments, orders and integrations with warehouses and accounting.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: React.js developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A React developer builds user interfaces from components: small, reusable pieces that keep their own state and render what the data says. React is the most widely used library for interactive web interfaces, and it is al

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Bubble.io developer
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: A Bubble developer builds web applications visually, with no traditional code. Bubble provides a database, page designer, workflows (logic) and privacy rules, so a single builder can deliver a working product.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.title: Advanced development: back end, security, performance, testing and deployment
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Development-.lead: The advanced topics that turn a demo into a product a business can depend on.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Lesson-Guide.lead: What you learn DOM manipulation. The DOM is the live tree of page elements. Plain JavaScript changes it directly; React describes the page from state and updates the DOM for you.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Lesson-Guide.title: Backend engineering and databases
handbook/Master-Freelancing-Lesson-Guide.lead: What you learn Node.js and Express. Node runs JavaScript on the server. Express adds routes and middleware: functions that run in order on each request (logging, auth, validation) before the route handler.

handbook/Master-Freelancing-Lesson-Guide.title: AI-assisted rapid development (vibe coding)
